facts.fact: 门球外交：ost Vonlin 三兄弟以 anteroque 球局拖延请愿者（Lorz 浮夸金链/Rorik 巨汉/Faün 沉默剑客体）——Angelica 认出这是「让请愿者等」的开场棋。
假处决余波：Ulshära 自供行刑是 posturing、ost Vonlins 果然求见——「They most certainly are (still making legionnaires)」——正去 Divine City 取更多羽毛；Risha 替 Dante 疗双角时手在颤。
Yvri 之思：fulcrum 毁灭论若真——「Would Deia go searching for him, for her family?」——她在 Dante 新角上看见龙的角。
facts.anchor: what did that mean for the wyvern?

facts.fact: 谈判爆发：Risha 摔句——「Why are we stalling?...They killed my father, Rath Vakara, head of my House. This will not go without consequences.」——Lorz 反提转攻 Noctus（「turn our sights upon Noctus...It would not be a difficult choice」）。
facts.anchor: They killed my father, Rath Vakara, head of my House.

facts.fact: 身体读伤：Risha 低声——「The oldest is favoring his left arm, and the biggest has a slight limp. I can’t get a read on the third.」——三个将军都带伤。
facts.anchor: The oldest is favoring his left arm

facts.fact: 交易达成：停造军团 换 Oskar 造武器——「It will be you, Imperator. Just like last time.」（Ulshära 曾代家族下委托）——她半个节拍后才稳住声音应下。
facts.anchor: “It will be you, Imperator. Just like last time.”

facts.fact: Deia 之扰与琴：无 Yvri 则门开不动、灼疤作痛——「I thought this was ending...I thought I was getting better.」——Cosima 递琴「Play for me」——琴曲安神、欲望以恋人为出口。
facts.anchor: I thought I was getting better.

facts.fact: 火烙羽：Cosima 之谋——烧掉 Ulshära 肩羽使 Phos 无处附体——皮革咬齿、Phos 幻听「There is no escape from me」——羽成黑灰——Ulshära 肩上留下 Deia 式手印疤：「Thank you.」
